title: Snort 3 Rule: Suspicious Outbound SMTP Authentication Bypass / Direct IP Connection
summary: Detects endpoint hosts attempting to connect directly to external SMTP relays on port 25/587 without traversing authorized corporate MTA smarthosts.
rule_syntax: alert tcp $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET [25, 465, 587] (msg:"TRACE-MAIL AI: Unauthorized Outbound SMTP Relay Detected"; flow:to_server,established; content:"HELO",nocase; metadata:service smtp, impact_flag red; sid:3000001; rev:1;)
usage: Deploy on internal gateway or perimeter sensor to detect malware-originated spam or forged relay injection.

title: Sigma Rule: Suspicious Inbox Auto-Forwarding Rule Created in Microsoft 365
summary: Detects the creation of mailbox inbox rules that automatically forward incoming emails to external domains (classic BEC persistence mechanism).
rule_syntax:
title: Suspicious Inbox Forwarding Rule Created
id: 7b2d51fb-0e12-4f81-8176-7916bfdf2101
status: production
description: Detects creation of forwarding rule in Exchange Online targeting external recipient.
logsource:
    product: m365
    service: exchange
detection:
    selection:
        Operation: 'New-InboxRule'
        Parameters|contains:
            - 'ForwardTo'
            - 'ForwardAsAttachmentTo'
            - 'RedirectTo'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate user forwarding (rare, audit required)
level: high
tags:
    - attack.collection
    - attack.t1114.003
usage: Ingest into SIEM (Splunk, Wazuh, Elastic) monitoring Microsoft 365 audit logs.

title: Perimeter Firewall: Automated IPTables / NFTables Host Quarantine Drop
summary: Immediate perimeter drop rule for malicious originating IP addresses or known attack relays.
rule_syntax:
sudo iptables -I INPUT -s {ORIGIN_IP} -j DROP
sudo iptables -I FORWARD -s {ORIGIN_IP} -j DROP
usage: Execute via SOAR or local command on the firewall to immediately sever inbound packets from the threat actor IP.
